title: plugin-grid / plugin-list: a list's $select never asks for a shown faced column's dependsOn siblings, so the Record Shares Recipient column draws the raw user id in four of its five views
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a user-visible defect on a served view, with a named landing. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 of objectstack-ai/objectstack (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118) · `os-support-ai` · `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y`, as one of the two console rules named by the seat ruling on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24701 (`6282390889`). That ruling's code landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #24831 (merge `99e4eaa227`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it to the lane that owns `packages/plugin-grid` / `packages/plugin-list`.

## What happens

- `sys_record_share.recipient_id` now declares `widget: 'recipient-picker'` and `dependsOn: ['recipient_type']`, the declaration `sys_sharing_rule.recipient_id` already carries. The face (objectui#12613) names a user id by the row's `recipient_type`.
- Setup → Access Control → Record Shares has five views that show `recipient_id`. Only `all_shares` also shows `recipient_type` as a column. `granted_by_me`, `by_object`, `manual_grants` and `rule_grants` show `recipient_id` alone.
- The list's `$select` does not ask for a shown column's `dependsOn` siblings, so in those four views the face receives no kind and draws the stored text: a raw user id. The maintainer's HotCRM pass measured the raw ids (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24701, comment `6283814156`).

## Where (read at objectstack's console pin `.objectui-sha` `12dc7b47c3` and objectui `main`, by code)

- `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `ListView.tsx` harvest extra `$select` fields from predicate operands (objectui#3501), grouping (objectui#7179), the concurrency token (objectui#12292), the row colour (objectui#12393), a deadline's `settledWhen` (objectui#11815) and a `referenceVia` type half (objectui#13036). There is no arm for a shown column's `dependsOn` siblings.
- `useRecipientLabel` (`refLabelDirectory.ts`) asks nothing when `recipient_type` is absent, and `RecipientCellFace` falls through to `TextCellRenderer`.

**Expected:** a shown column whose field declares `dependsOn` gets those siblings fetched, the same way objectui#13036 fetches a `referenceVia` type half. The rule is driven by the declaration. ⛔ No name-to-label mapping in the console, and ⛔ no column added to the views to feed the face.

## Dedupe

objectui, MCP `search_issues`, open and closed, "list grid projection select dependsOn sibling of a faced column widget recipient-picker not fetched": 13 hits.
- objectui#13036 (closed) is the `referenceVia` arm of the same projection.
- objectui#7165 (closed) is the inline editor's `dependsOn` values.
- Neither covers a shown column's `dependsOn`. **New.**

Dedupe words: $select dependsOn sibling; faced column projection; recipient column raw id list.
